en.title: Nvidia Hit by SEC Accounting Probe as Shares Plunge 14% in a Day
en.excerpt: Reuters reports the SEC is examining potential accounting issues at Nvidia; the chipmaker fell 14.01% on November 20, capping a seven-week slide that erased about $2.6 trillion in market value.
en.content:
Reuters reported on November 20, citing two people briefed on the matter, that the US Securities and Exchange Commission's enforcement staff are examining potential accounting issues at Nvidia. The company and the SEC both declined to comment. Reuters stressed that an investigation is not evidence of wrongdoing and that many inquiries close without enforcement action.

**Market reaction was severe.** Nvidia closed down 14.01% at $125.53, about 48% below its October peak of $243.37. It was the seventh straight weekly decline, the longest losing streak since the 2008 financial crisis. Over seven weeks the stock has fallen roughly 46%, erasing about $2.6 trillion in market value; a single session wiped out close to $490 billion. Market cap slid to about $3.03 trillion, fourth behind Apple, Microsoft and Alphabet, and the forward P/E compressed to roughly 8.4x.

The probe lands amid broader anxiety about **circular AI financing** — chipmakers helping customers fund chip purchases and data centres, which critics say obscures revenue quality. Interim CEO Colette Kress said on the earnings call that Nvidia would be far more selective about AI-industry financing deals. The Justice Department is separately reviewing Nvidia's $12.9 billion deal to buy Hugging Face.

**What to watch:** any official statement from Nvidia or the SEC, and whether the selloff spreads to the wider AI-infrastructure complex.

zh.title: 英伟达遭美国 SEC 会计调查，股价单日暴跌 14%
zh.excerpt: 路透社称 SEC 正审查英伟达潜在会计问题；11 月 20 日股价重挫 14.01%，七周累计蒸发约 2.6 万亿美元市值。
zh.content:
路透社 11 月 20 日援引两名知情人士报道，美国证券交易委员会（SEC）执法部门正在审查英伟达可能存在的会计问题。英伟达与 SEC 均拒绝置评。路透社强调，调查并不代表存在不当行为，许多调查最终并未导致执法行动。

**市场反应剧烈。** 英伟达当日收跌 14.01%，报 125.53 美元，较 10 月 243.37 美元的历史高点下跌约 48%。这是连续第七周下跌，创 2008 年金融危机以来最长连跌纪录。七周累计跌幅约 46%，市值蒸发约 2.6 万亿美元，仅 11 月 20 日单日就蒸发近 4900 亿美元。公司总市值降至约 3.03 万亿美元，排名滑落至苹果、微软、Alphabet 之后位列第四，预估本益比压缩至约 8.4 倍。

调查之际，外界对**循环式 AI 融资**的担忧升温——芯片厂商协助客户融资购买芯片与建设数据中心，批评者认为这令收入质量更难评估。临时首席执行官 Colette Kress 在财报电话会上表示，未来对 AI 行业融资交易将更加挑剔。美国司法部另在审查英伟达以 129 亿美元收购 Hugging Face 的交易。

**后续关注：** 英伟达或 SEC 的官方表态，以及抛售是否蔓延至更广泛的 AI 基建板块。

en.title: Trump and Xi Agree Military AI Decisions Must Involve Humans, Bessent Says
en.excerpt: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the two leaders agreed that AI-driven military decisions require human involvement and that major military actions should not be fully autonomous.
en.content:
US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told CNBC on November 20 that President Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping agreed that humans should always be involved in military decisions that use artificial intelligence, even as the two countries compete for AI leadership. Bessent was speaking after returning from Trump's meeting with Xi in Shenzhen.

Using the administration's preferred term super intelligence (SI), Bessent said the two sides agreed that no major military operation should be launched without a human being involved, and that SI should not be allowed to operate autonomously in major military actions. He said the understanding would not be affected by the broader AI rivalry.

**On chips**, Bessent said the H200 remains the most advanced Nvidia chip China can buy with a licence, but noted few Chinese orders as Beijing builds its own chip stack. He said the Commerce Department had moved to curb Chinese access to advanced chips, including those used by overseas data centres where Chinese firms can rent computing power.

The agreement is a rare point of convergence on AI safety rules between two otherwise competing powers, though Bessent gave no detail on any enforcement mechanism or written text.

zh.title: 美财长称川习达成共识：军事 AI 决策须有人类参与
zh.excerpt: 美国财长贝森特表示，两国领导人同意 AI 军事决策需人类参与，重大军事行动不应完全自主运作。
zh.content:
美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特 11 月 20 日接受 CNBC 采访时表示，美国总统特朗普与中国国家主席习近平达成共识：凡是使用人工智能的军事决策，都必须有人的参与，尽管两国仍在 AI 领域竞争。贝森特是在陪同特朗普结束深圳会晤后作出上述表态。

贝森特使用本届政府偏好的说法「超级智能」（SI），称双方同意任何重大军事行动都不应在没有人类参与的情况下发起，SI 不应被允许在重大军事行动中自主运作。他表示，这一共识不会受到更广泛 AI 竞赛的影响。

**芯片方面**，贝森特称 H200 仍是中国凭借许可证可采购的最先进英伟达芯片，但由于中国正建设自有芯片体系，订单数量稀少。他还说，美国商务部已采取行动限制中国获取先进芯片，包括中国企业可租用算力的海外数据中心所用芯片。

这是两个竞争大国在 AI 安全规则上罕见的 convergent 共识，但贝森特未说明任何执行机制或书面文本细节。

en.title: Signal Blocks Screenshots by Default to Stop Siri and Gemini Reading Private Chats
en.excerpt: Signal president Meredith Whittaker called OS-level AI agents an existential threat and shipped defaults that stop assistants from scanning encrypted messages off the screen.
en.content:
Encrypted messenger Signal rolled out iOS and Android updates that block AI assistants such as Apple's Siri and Google's Gemini from reading private messages off the screen. President Meredith Whittaker announced the move on November 20, calling OS-level AI integrations an existential threat to the app's privacy mission.

**How it works:** on iOS 27 with Signal 8.37 or later, a new Block Siri AI setting is on by default, preventing screenshots and screen recordings inside the app; users can disable it for ten minutes or permanently. On Android, Signal 8.35.1 and later automatically enables its existing Screen security setting when it detects an AI assistant trying to read the screen — a detection-based approach chosen because vendor fragmentation makes reliable screenshot detection impossible on many devices.

The logic is direct: end-to-end encryption protects messages in transit, but an assistant with onscreen awareness reads the same decrypted text you do, and whatever it captures lands in a local database or remote server outside Signal's control. The move follows a Reuters investigation published on November 18 describing how Meta's Muse agent could read Signal messages through notification access on Android and accessibility permissions on macOS.

**The fix is incomplete.** Signal says it cannot reliably block screenshots on macOS because Apple provides no documented developer tools, and blocking screenshots does nothing about agents that pull data from the filesystem. It is calling on Apple, Google and Microsoft to provide a simple, documented way for apps to opt out of AI data access.

zh.title: Signal 默认屏蔽截图，阻止 Siri 与 Gemini 读取私信
zh.excerpt: Signal 总裁称系统级 AI 智能体是「生存威胁」，新版本默认阻止助手扫描屏幕上的加密消息。
zh.content:
端到端加密聊天应用 Signal 推出 iOS 与 Android 更新，阻止苹果 Siri、谷歌 Gemini 等 AI 助手从屏幕上读取私人消息。Signal 总裁 Meredith Whittaker 于 11 月 20 日宣布此事，称系统级 AI 集成对该应用的隐私使命构成「生存威胁」。

**实现方式：** 在运行 iOS 27 的设备上，Signal 8.37 及更高版本默认开启「阻止 Siri AI」设置，禁止应用内截图与录屏，用户可选择关闭 10 分钟或永久禁用。在 Android 上，Signal 8.35.1 及以上版本检测到 AI 助手试图读取屏幕时，会自动开启原有的「屏幕安全」策略——由于各厂商实现差异，很多设备无法可靠检测截图，因此采用基于行为检测的方案。

逻辑很直接：端对端加密保护传输中的消息，但具备屏幕感知能力的助手读取的是你眼前同一份已解密文本，捕获的内容会落到 Signal 控制之外的本地数据库或远程服务器。此举紧随路透社 11 月 18 日的调查——该报道描述 Meta 的 Muse 智能体如何通过 Android 通知权限与 macOS 辅助功能权限读取 Signal 消息。

**修复并不完整。** Signal 表示，由于苹果未提供有文档支持的开发工具，macOS 版无法可靠屏蔽截图；而屏蔽截图也无法阻止从文件系统取数的智能体。Signal 呼吁苹果、谷歌与微软提供简单、有文档的方式，让应用可以选择退出 AI 数据访问。

en.title: Gemini Can Now Call Businesses on Your Behalf, Free in Six Countries
en.excerpt: Google's Duplex arrives in Tasks in the Gemini app: it dials shops, waits on hold, books the slot and adds it to Calendar, identifying itself as an AI on every call.
en.content:
Google has brought its Duplex calling capability into Tasks in the Gemini app, letting the assistant phone businesses on the user's behalf. The feature is free in the United States, Japan, South Korea, Canada, Australia and India, and is excluded in five US states.

**What it does:** Gemini will ring a shop, wait on hold, book an appointment and add it to Google Calendar. The system discloses that it is an AI at the start of every call, and merchants can opt out. Google traces the feature's architecture back a decade — from pre-LLM closed-domain models, through hybrid stacks with LaMDA, to a unified Gemini-based calling stack.

The rollout uses Gemini 4 models including Gemini 4 Hydrogen and Gemini 4 Neon, and adds bill analysis, Agent Payments Protocol transactions, and coordination via email and RCS. It is the latest expression of a broader push to turn assistants from chat interfaces into agents that take real-world actions.

**Caveats:** availability is limited to six countries and five US states are excluded, so the practical reach is uneven. Google has published its own caveats about how the system handles calls.

zh.title: Gemini 现可代用户拨打电话，在六个国家免费开放
zh.excerpt: 谷歌将 Duplex 通话能力接入 Gemini 应用的 Tasks：可替用户致电商家、等待接通、完成预约并写入日历，通话中声明自己是 AI。
zh.content:
谷歌已将 Duplex 通话能力引入 Gemini 应用的 Tasks 功能，让助手可以替用户致电商家。该功能在美国、日本、韩国、加拿大、澳大利亚与印度免费开放，美国有五个州不在支持范围内。

**能做什么：** Gemini 会拨打商家电话、等待接通、完成预约，并将日程加入 Google 日历。系统会在每通电话开始时声明自己是 AI，商家也可选择退出。谷歌追溯了该功能十年的架构演进——从大模型之前的封闭领域模型，到与 LaMDA 结合的混合架构，再到如今统一的基于 Gemini 的通话栈。

本次上线使用 Gemini 4 系列模型（含 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 与 Gemini 4 Neon），并新增账单分析、Agent Payments Protocol 交易能力，以及通过邮件与 RCS 进行协调。这是把助手从对话界面转变为能采取真实世界行动的智能体这一大趋势的最新体现。

**注意：** 功能仅覆盖六国，且美国五州被排除，实际可用范围并不均衡。谷歌也已公布系统处理通话时的相关注意事项。

en.title: TSMC Halts Chinese Orders at 16nm and Below Under Tighter US Rules
en.excerpt: New Commerce Department rules that took effect November 19 closed a verification route, forcing TSMC to require US export licences for advanced Chinese chip orders.
en.content:
TSMC is tightening restrictions on Chinese chip designers, suspending some previously permitted advanced manufacturing orders, according to two people familiar with the matter cited by Reuters. The world's largest contract chipmaker has instructed that affected orders using processes of 16 nanometres and below be halted unless customers obtain US export licences.

**What changed:** new US Commerce Department rules that took effect on November 19 removed a compliance route that had let TSMC assess a Chinese chip design's computing power to decide whether it fell outside export controls. Under the new rules, affected advanced chips are presumed covered by US controls, requiring a licence unless an exception applies. Chinese designers are generally limited to older 28nm and 40nm processes, provided their chips use no high-bandwidth memory and no advanced packaging.

TSMC's guidance also requires closer scrutiny of customers' operating locations, parent companies, major shareholders, packaging providers and shipping routes, including orders placed through overseas subsidiaries or intermediaries in Taiwan, the US, Europe, Japan and Southeast Asia. TSMC said it would comply with the new Bureau of Industry and Security regulations where applicable.

**Why it matters:** most leading AI chips are made at 7nm or below. The move could close one of the last routes for Chinese firms to produce powerful AI processors, complicating Beijing's effort to build domestic alternatives to Nvidia-designed, TSMC-manufactured chips.

zh.title: 美国新规生效，台积电暂停中国 16 纳米及以下订单
zh.excerpt: 11 月 19 日生效的商务部新规取消原有验证通道，台积电对中国先进制程订单转而要求美国出口许可。
zh.content:
据路透社援引两名知情人士报道，台积电正收紧对中国芯片设计企业的限制，暂停部分此前获准的先进制程订单。这家全球最大晶圆代工厂已指示，受影响的 16 纳米及以下制程订单必须暂停，除非客户取得美国出口许可证。

**变化所在：** 11 月 19 日生效的美国商务部新规，取消了此前允许台积电通过评估中国芯片算力来判断是否受出口管制的合规通道。新规下，受影响的先进芯片被推定为受美国管制，除非符合例外条款，否则必须取得许可证。中国设计企业原则上被限制在较成熟的 28 纳米与 40 纳米制程，且芯片不得使用高带宽内存（HBM）与先进封装。

台积电指引还要求更严格审查客户的实际运营地点、母公司、主要股东、封装供应商与出货路线，涵盖通过台湾、美国、欧洲、日本及东南亚子公司或中间商下达的订单。台积电表示将遵循适用的美国工业与安全局（BIS）新规。

**重要性：** 多数领先 AI 芯片采用 7 纳米及以下工艺生产。此举可能封堵中国企业制造高性能 AI 处理器的最后通道之一，使北京研发英伟达设计、台积电制造芯片的国产替代品更加困难。

en.title: MIT Spinout Boltz Raises $110M to Sell AI Drug Design by the Token
en.excerpt: Bessemer led the Series A for the London-based lab whose open-source models were downloaded five million times and whose commercial models are used by six of the top 20 drugmakers.
en.content:
Boltz, an AI drug-discovery lab spun out of MIT and now based in London, raised a $110 million Series A led by Bessemer Venture Partners, with Andreessen Horowitz and others participating. The round, announced on November 18, follows a $28 million seed earlier this year.

**Open models first, then usage pricing.** The three founders came out of Regina Barzilay's lab at MIT; their open-source Boltz models predict how molecules bind to proteins and match closed rivals such as DeepMind's AlphaFold3. Bessemer says the models have over 5 million downloads and are used by more than 100,000 scientists. The company now sells proprietary models — BoltzMol-1 for small molecules and BoltzProt-1 for protein design — through its Boltz Lab and an API billed on molecular tokens, the way a lab buys reagents. The API also plugs into agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Gemini.

**Traction and claims:** Boltz says six of the world's 20 largest drugmakers, including Pfizer, GSK, Takeda and Bristol Myers Squibb, are partners, and that weekly token use has grown roughly 50-fold since June. The company reports BoltzMol-1 found small-molecule hits against six of ten targets while testing only 28 to 51 compounds each, with costs as low as $10,000 — figures that are the company's own.

**The open question** is whether usage-priced AI sold to pharma research teams scales into production budgets, and whether the models actually produce medicines rather than promising molecules.

zh.title: MIT 衍生公司 Boltz 融资 1.1 亿美元，把 AI 制药做成 token 生意
zh.excerpt: Bessemer 领投这家总部位于伦敦的实验室 A 轮；其开源模型下载超 500 万次，商业模型已进入全球前 20 药企中的六家。
zh.content:
从 MIT 分拆、现总部位于伦敦的 AI 药物研发实验室 Boltz，完成由 Bessemer Venture Partners 领投的 1.1 亿美元 A 轮融资，Andreessen Horowitz 等跟投。本轮于 11 月 18 日宣布，距今年早些时候的 2800 万美元种子轮不到一年。

**先开源、再按用量收费。** 三位创始人出自 MIT 的 Regina Barzilay 实验室，其开源 Boltz 模型可预测分子与蛋白质的结合方式，性能对标 DeepMind 的 AlphaFold3 等闭源模型。Bessemer 称这些模型下载量超过 500 万次，被 10 万余名科学家使用。公司如今通过 Boltz Lab 与 API 出售专有模型——面向小分子的 BoltzMol-1 与面向蛋白设计的 BoltzProt-1，按「分子 token」计费，类似实验室采购试剂；该 API 还能接入 Claude Code、Codex 与 Gemini 等智能体。

**进展与自报数据：** Boltz 称全球前 20 大药企中有六家是客户，包括辉瑞、GSK、武田与百时美施贵宝，每周 token 用量自 6 月以来增长约 50 倍。公司表示 BoltzMol-1 在 10 个靶点中的 6 个找到小分子 hits，每个仅测试 28 至 51 个化合物，成本可低至 1 万美元——这些均为公司自报数据。

**待观察的问题** 是：面向药企研发团队、按用量收费的 AI 能否扩大为生产级预算，以及这些模型是否能真正产出药物，而不只是有前景的分子。

en.title: Tesla Ramps Early Optimus Gen3 Production and Promises a Real-World Demo
en.excerpt: Musk says Tesla will show an unscripted Optimus demo within two months; Gen3 is in early production at Fremont at several hundred units a week.
en.content:
Elon Musk said in a November 18 appearance at the TomorrowX summit that Tesla plans to show a real, unscripted demonstration of its Optimus humanoid within the next one to two months — not a pre-programmed single-task routine, not reliant on behind-the-scenes teleoperation, and not confined to a controlled environment. He cited programmer John Carmack's test: walk over, pick up a boxed remote-control car, open it, unscrew the battery compartment, insert batteries, screw it back and drive the car.

**Hardware and production:** the third-generation Optimus carries 37 joints and a new dexterous hand. Early production began at Tesla's Fremont factory in Q3 2026 at several hundred units per week — about ten times Q2 output. The units are not for external delivery; they are deployed in the internal Optimus Academy programme and on factory floors to collect training data via a reinforcement-learning loop.

**Capacity build-out:** the dedicated Optimus factory at Giga Texas spans more than 7 million square feet. As of November 18 its main structure was about 65% assembled, with enclosure targeted for year-end, initial production in late 2026 and mass production in summer 2027.

**Caveats:** the demo is still a promise, and past Optimus showcases drew criticism for partial teleoperation. Musk's timeline — household chores in 12 to 18 months, external deliveries around late 2027, initially likely as leases — is a company statement, not a verified milestone.

zh.title: 特斯拉启动 Optimus Gen3 早期量产，预告两个月内展示真实能力
zh.excerpt: 马斯克称两个月内展示不靠预编程的 Optimus 演示；Gen3 已在弗里蒙特工厂早期量产，周产数百台。
zh.content:
马斯克 11 月 18 日在 TomorrowX 峰会连线中表示，特斯拉计划在未来一到两个月内展示 Optimus 人形机器人的「真实」演示——不采用预先写死的单一任务流程，不依赖后台遥操作，也不局限于可控环境。他引用程序员约翰·卡马克提出的测试标准：走过去拿起一盒遥控玩具车，拆开包装，拧开电池仓螺丝，装入电池，拧回去，再驱动小车行驶。

**硬件与产能：** 第三代 Optimus 配备 37 个关节与全新灵巧手，2026 年第三季度起在弗里蒙特工厂启动早期量产，目前每周生产数百台，约为第二季度的十倍。这批机器人暂不对外交付，而是部署在内部「Optimus 学院」项目与工厂车间，通过强化学习循环采集训练数据。

**产能建设：** 得州超级工厂中专供 Optimus 的工厂占地超过 700 万平方英尺。截至 11 月 18 日主体结构组装完成约 65%，计划年底封顶，2026 年底启动初期生产，2027 年夏季实现大规模量产。

**需注意：** 演示目前仍是预告，过往 Optimus 展示曾因部分依赖遥操作而受质疑。马斯克给出的时间表——12 至 18 个月内可做家务、2027 年底左右对外交付且初期可能采用租赁——是公司表态，尚非已验证的里程碑。

en.title: Ideogram 4.6 Brings Precise Edits in Native 4K
en.excerpt: The November 19 release generates up to 4096×4096 without upscaling and adds a masked Precise Edit endpoint; the company claims top spot on a multi-step editing leaderboard.
en.content:
Ideogram released version 4.6 on November 19, an image generation and editing model built for precise, step-by-step control. Its headline feature is native 4K: images are generated at full resolution up to 4096 by 4096 pixels rather than upscaled from a smaller image.

**Two API endpoints.** Generate creates images from a prompt and can take up to five reference images. Precise Edit changes a region of an existing image, accepts an optional mask, and returns it at the source's exact dimensions; localized edits keep a 4K or 8K source at full resolution. Ideogram says it worked to remove the AI look and waxy skin, and reports big gains in holding exact values — exact colour matching rose from 46% to 83% and small product-defect repair from 61% to 86% in its own tests.

**Benchmark, with caution.** Ideogram says 4.6 ranks first on Rapidata's Multi-step Image Edit leaderboard with 1,892 points, ahead of Seedream 5.5 and FLUX 3 Image. Independent outlets note the gap to its own 4.5 is only 26 points with overlapping error margins, and the ranking appears mainly in Ideogram's own posts rather than an independent site — treat it as a vendor claim.

**Pricing and availability:** images start at $0.008 at very low quality; a high-quality 4K Precise Edit costs about $0.60. The model is live in the Ideogram app, the API and partners including Leonardo, Runway, fal and Comfy. Open weights are promised but undated.

zh.title: Ideogram 4.6 发布：原生 4K 分辨率下的精确图像编辑
zh.excerpt: 11 月 19 日发布的模型最高可原生生成 4096×4096 图像，新增支持遮罩的 Precise Edit 端点；厂商称在多步编辑榜排名第一。
zh.content:
Ideogram 于 11 月 19 日发布 4.6 版本，主打精确、可逐步控制的图像生成与编辑。其核心特性是原生 4K：图像以最高 4096×4096 的全分辨率直接生成，而非从较小图像放大。

**两个 API 端点。** Generate 根据提示词生成图像，可接受最多五张参考图；Precise Edit 修改已有图像的局部区域，支持可选遮罩，并按源图的精确尺寸返回结果——局部编辑可让 4K 或 8K 源图保持全分辨率。Ideogram 称着力消除「AI 味」和蜡像皮肤，并在自测中报告保持精确数值的能力大幅提升：精确配色从 46% 升至 83%，小产品缺陷修复从 61% 升至 86%。

**榜单需谨慎看待。** Ideogram 称 4.6 以 1892 分位列 Rapidata 多步图像编辑榜第一，领先 Seedream 5.5 与 FLUX 3 Image。独立媒体指出，它与自家 4.5 仅差 26 分、误差区间重叠，且该排名主要出现在 Ideogram 自己的帖子而非独立站点——应视为厂商自述。

**定价与可用性：** 图像最低 0.008 美元/张，高质量 4K 精确编辑约 0.60 美元/张。模型已上线 Ideogram 应用、API，以及 Leonardo、Runway、fal、Comfy 等合作平台。开放权重已承诺但尚无日期。

en.title: A Small LoRA Makes the Same Model 16 Points Better Inside an Agent Harness
en.excerpt: Hugging Face's harness adapters freeze the base model and RL-train a per-runtime LoRA: Qwen3.8-27B jumped from 39.5% to 55.8% on Terminal-Bench while halving token use.
en.content:
Hugging Face published an open recipe for adapting a model to a specific agent harness: freeze the base weights and train a separate LoRA adapter with reinforcement learning inside the harness's own unmodified runtime. The base model was Qwen3.8-27B; the three harnesses were pi, OpenCode and Hermes Agent.

**Why bother:** general-purpose models target average performance, not a particular harness and task mix, leaving accuracy and tokens on the table. A proxy between the harness and vLLM captures the exact tokens generated so the model trains against the same tool calls, prompt formatting and failure modes it will see in production. Each adapter was trained with TRL's AsyncGRPOTrainer; a safeagents plugin checked 1.3 million tool calls across runs and blocked 647.

**Reported results** (Hugging Face's own, with no independent reproduction): under pi with thinking off, Terminal-Bench 2.1 accuracy went from 39.5% to 55.8% (+16.3 points, p=0.0013) while average token use per task fell from about 2.9K to 1.5K. Tools calls dropped 53–72% on tasks both versions solved. The three LoRAs are nearly orthogonal (cosine similarity around 0.01–0.02) and were merged into a single super-adapter that runs unchanged across all three harnesses.

**Caveats:** numbers are self-reported with no error bars in the launch post, evaluated only at 27B on three harnesses, and one key benchmark has just 51 tasks. Still, adapters, GGUFs, RL tasks and ready-to-use Docker images are public, so teams can verify on their own workload.

zh.title: 小 LoRA 让同一模型在智能体运行环境中提升 16 分
zh.excerpt: Hugging Face 的 harness adapters 冻结基座模型、针对每种运行时用强化学习训练 LoRA：Qwen3.8-27B 在 Terminal-Bench 上从 39.5% 升至 55.8%，token 用量减半。
zh.content:
Hugging Face 发布了一套开放方案，用于让模型适配特定的智能体运行环境（harness）：冻结基座权重，在 harness 未经修改的运行时内部，用强化学习训练一个独立的 LoRA 适配器。基座模型为 Qwen3.8-27B，三个 harness 分别是 pi、OpenCode 与 Hermes Agent。

**为什么要做：** 通用模型追求平均表现，而非针对某个运行环境与任务组合优化，因而损失了准确率与 token 效率。方案在 harness 与 vLLM 之间放置代理，捕获模型实际生成的 token，使训练针对生产环境中完全相同的工具调用、提示格式与失败模式进行。每个适配器用 TRL 的 AsyncGRPOTrainer 训练；safeagents 插件在多轮训练中检查了 130 万次工具调用，拦截 647 次。

**自报结果**（来自 Hugging Face，尚无独立复现）：在 pi 环境、关闭思考模式下，Terminal-Bench 2.1 准确率从 39.5% 升至 55.8%（+16.3 分，p=0.0013），每任务平均 token 用量从约 2.9K 降至 1.5K。在两个版本都能解决的任务上，工具调用减少 53%–72%。三个 LoRA 几乎正交（余弦相似度约 0.01–0.02），已合并为可在三个环境下不加修改运行的 super-adapter。

**需注意：** 数据均为自报，发布文章未给出误差区间，仅在 27B 规模与三个环境上评测，其中一个关键基准只有 51 道题。不过适配器、GGUF、RL 任务与即用 Docker 镜像均已公开，团队可在自己的任务上验证。

en.title: Oracle Says It Is Fully Funded for Its $300 Billion OpenAI Cloud Contract
en.excerpt: Oracle says it has secured the capital to fulfil the five-year deal, capping new fundraising at $20 billion through FY2030 — a company claim made amid scrutiny of AI-linked credit.
en.content:
Oracle said on November 20 that it has secured the capital needed to fulfil its cloud infrastructure contract with OpenAI, describing itself as the first hyperscaler fully funded for the current AI investment cycle. The agreement is described as five-year and worth $300 billion.

**The funding framework:** at its investor day Oracle committed to capping additional capital-markets fundraising for fiscal 2027 through fiscal 2030 at $20 billion, split evenly between $10 billion in equity and $10 billion in gross debt, excluding refinancing — on top of a $20 billion at-the-market equity raise completed in Q1 FY2027. Oracle pre-empted future questions, saying ongoing private supplier discussions are optional rather than required to meet contractual obligations.

**Sites:** construction at Abilene, where OpenAI's Astra-6 model was trained, is nearing completion; the next gigawatt-scale site, Shackelford, has full permitting; handover of Nvidia Vera Rubin server racks remains scheduled for the coming weeks. Oracle reiterated expectations of positive free cash flow in H2 FY2028 and more than $30 billion annually in FY2029.

**Read with care:** these are company statements, made in a week when AI-linked credit was under scrutiny and Oracle shares closed down 8.48% before rebounding about 3.5% after hours. The market's core anxiety about the AI build-out is funding, not demand.

zh.title: Oracle 称已为 3000 亿美元 OpenAI 云合同备足资金
zh.excerpt: Oracle 表示已获得履行这份五年期合同所需资本，并承诺 FY2030 前新增融资上限 200 亿美元——此为公司在 AI 信贷受审视之际的自述。
zh.content:
Oracle 于 11 月 20 日表示，已获得履行与 OpenAI 云基础设施合同所需资本，自称是「首个为当前 AI 投资周期完全融资的超大规模厂商」。该协议被描述为五年期、价值 3000 亿美元。

**融资框架：** 在投资者日，Oracle 承诺将 2027 至 2030 财年新增资本市场融资上限设为 200 亿美元，股权与债务各 100 亿美元（不含债务再融资），此外还在 2027 财年第一季度完成了 200 亿美元的场内股票增发。Oracle 主动回应外界疑问，称与供应商的持续私下讨论是可选安排，而非履行合同义务所必需。

**站点进展：** 用于训练 OpenAI Astra-6 模型的 Abilene 站点建设接近完工；下一个吉瓦级站点 Shackelford 已取得全部许可；英伟达 Vera Rubin 服务器机架预计未来数周交付。Oracle 重申预计 2028 财年下半年自由现金流转正，2029 财年年度自由现金流超过 300 亿美元。

**需谨慎看待：** 这些均为公司表态，发布之际正值 AI 相关信贷受审视——当周 Oracle 股价收跌 8.48%，盘后反弹约 3.5%。市场对 AI 建设的核心焦虑在于融资，而非需求。

en.title: Google Previews Tool Retrieval so Agents Load Schemas Only When Needed
en.excerpt: The Interactions API preview keeps tool names and descriptions available and loads full parameter schemas on demand, targeting large tool libraries — though Google gives no measured savings.
en.content:
Google has released a preview of Tool Retrieval in the Gemini Interactions API. The feature keeps the names and descriptions of many tools available to an agent while loading full parameter schemas only when a tool is actually needed.

**Why it matters:** large tool libraries can consume a large share of the prompt context just by defining every schema. Loading definitions on demand frees that space for reasoning and content. The preview supports Gemini 3.6 and later models, including Gemini 4, and works with remote MCP servers.

**Engineering caveats:** the feature currently requires the v1beta API and does not support the older generate-content method. Server-side search triggers an additional billed model call, and standard token charges still apply. Google has not published a measured savings figure in the announcement, so teams will need to benchmark the effect on their own tool sets and check which actions their agents can actually execute.

The release is part of a wider move toward making agent APIs more context-efficient, arriving the same week that Hugging Face published harness adapters aimed at cutting agent token consumption.

zh.title: 谷歌预览工具检索：智能体仅在需要时加载工具参数定义
zh.excerpt: Interactions API 预览保留工具名称与描述，按需加载完整参数 schema，面向大型工具库——但谷歌未给出实测节省数据。
zh.content:
谷歌在 Gemini Interactions API 中发布「工具检索」（Tool Retrieval）预览。该功能让智能体始终可见大量工具的名称与描述，仅在真正需要某个工具时才加载其完整参数 schema。

**为何重要：** 大型工具库仅仅定义每个 schema，就可能占用提示上下文的大量空间。按需加载定义可把这部分空间腾给推理与内容。该预览支持 Gemini 3.6 及更新模型（含 Gemini 4），并兼容远程 MCP 服务器。

**工程注意事项：** 该功能目前要求使用 v1beta API，不支持较旧的 generate-content 方法；服务端搜索会触发一次额外计费的模型调用，标准 token 费用照常计算。谷歌在公告中未给出实测节省数据，因此团队需要在自己的工具集上做基准测试，并核查智能体实际能执行哪些动作。

此次发布是让智能体 API 更节省上下文的更广泛趋势的一部分，与同一周 Hugging Face 发布旨在降低智能体 token 消耗的 harness adapters 相呼应。
